Maria (CS): Quick pulse — post-go-live for Novara. Saw two latency blips during onboarding warmup. Need SLO acceptance evidence for renewal call next Tue.
AJ (Platform): I can pull 72h p50/p95/p99 tail latencies and the autoscaler logs. Will post dashboard link in a bit.
Sam (SRE): Noted. Root cause was autoscaler cooldown + heavy batch traffic around 03:20 UTC. We mitigated with manual scale-up.
Ellie (SE): I already shared the customer-facing dashboard and the warmup checklist. Novara asked about potential credits if SLO breached.
Maria (CS): @AJ, @Sam — what's our current month uptime for Novara? SLA says credit if monthly uptime < 99.9%.
AJ (Platform): Running quick query:
```
SELECT 1 - SUM(downtime_minutes)/(30*24*60) as uptime FROM service_incidents
WHERE customer = 'novara' AND month = '2026-03';
```
AJ (Platform): Early calc shows uptime ~ 99.95% (so no automatic credit trigger) but two short latency incidents did impact request-level SLA for 3 customers.
Sam (SRE): We have incident IDs INC-5421 and INC-5422; both were ~4–6min tail latency spikes. Ops confirmed no data loss.
Ellie (SE): Customer's CSM is nervous. They want an itemized evidence bundle (graphs, span traces, incident timeline) and a short note explaining mitigations.
Maria (CS): Ok — plan: AJ posts dashboards + raw logs, Sam writes a 3-bullet RCA, Ellie prepares customer note and runs through credits calc with finance. I'll prep renewal playbook slide.
DeployBot: Deployment 2026-03-16T03:45Z to prod completed by aj-platform — no change flagged in health checks :white_check_mark:
AJ (Platform): I'll drop links by EOD and attach the uptime query results. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): Thanks team — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize the evidence pack before the renewal call.
